title: feat: Add vertical line to gantt plot at specified time
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR introduces support for a "vert" tag to display a vertical line marker on the bar chart at a specified date. This works similarly to the "milestone" tag and can be used to highlight significant points in time, such as the start or end of an event.

Resolves #3250 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

- Added a "vert" tag to the task attribute list, which signals the system to render a vertical line and label at a given time. 
- The vertical line is drawn within the chart area; the label is centered below the chart, aligned with the line. 
- Both the line and its label are rendered in a fixed navy color to distinguish them from standard chart elements. 
- The layout adjusts dynamically to accommodate any number of tasks and maintain clarity.
